diagnosis: The checks do not enforce several stated acceptance conditions: C6 records only a boolean, while C7 and C8 can both be satisfied by a generic trade_terms or access_logistics commitment without any actual access or occupancy details. PF3 is therefore not genuinely decisive, and an invalid settlement can pass all checks.
evidence: A settlement with cash_alternative_recorded=True and commitments containing only {"type":"trade_terms","target":"","detail":"noted"} passes C6-C8 without recording $900, Friday 18:00 collection, gate/key logistics, or the occupancy limit.
